title: Wiki tier promotion + deprecation logic
description: Implement the WikiEntry tier lifecycle: Hypothesis -> Validated -> Canonical -> Deprecated, based on evidence count thresholds from SPEC 5.2. Validated at >=5 evidence (p<0.1), Canonical at >=20 evidence cross-niche replicated, Deprecated when contradicted by >=3 recent fails. Safety or human promotes from review queue.
sub_tasks: Implement TierPromoter with promote(entry, new_evidence) -> updated tier
Implement deprecation check (>=3 contradicting fails -> Deprecated)
Wire promote path: review_queue -> tier check -> canonical if approved
Unit tests for all tier transitions + edge cases
